notes.title: Update - 6 New Levels and Music!
notes.notes:
As promised, the new release is now live. World 3 is now accessible with 6 new levels. I brought back a few original levels that had interesting elements, and included 4 all new designs. World 3-6 should challenge even the best players. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26343756/498aefda5bc796b4e342a10e51de740120a76d36.jpg[/img]

Music has been added to all of the stages as well. I hope you find the music fits the gameplay. 

For the next update (due April 6th), I'm working on the following:

[list]
[*] Sound FX
[*] Haptics (Rumble when grabbing)
[*] Replay enhancements (proper scaling, player model, name, etc.)
[*] Achievements - work is underway but not ready for release
[/list]

If you have problems or feedback, please let me know on the Steam Discussion Boards. 

Thank you and have fun!

-VRoximity

notes.title: Big Release! New levels. Earn medals. Race your replay ghost.
notes.notes:
Today is a big day for Awesome Obstacle Challenge. Many of the features I've been working on for months are finally released, and I'm excited for everyone to try them out. 

With most of the game features in place, I can finally focus on creating awesome levels. The best is definitely yet to come. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26343756/3e762da35ba73fd2070a2dedb81f797dda7beda5.jpg[/img]

Here are the new features in today's release:

[b]Level Progression[/b] - Pass a level to unlock the next. Once unlocked, you can skip to a level any time. 

[b]Medals[/b] - You can earn Gold, Silver, and Bronze medals on each level. 

[b]Replay Ghosts[/b] - Your best run on each level will be saved. You can race your "ghost" to improve your time. 

[b]New Levels![/b] - 6 new levels showcasing some new gameplay and enhanced graphics. 

[b]Enhanced Menu[/b] - The menu system has been improved. The menu shows your best time for each level, the medal time requirements, and which medals you've earned. A screenshot for each level is shown too. 

If you have questions or run into any issues, please post on the STEAM forums. 

As always, thank you for your support and have FUN!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26343756/5f9f8340cbd9b5f20eaf833e50a7176dba0f7865.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26343756/38ab88db7ed1ec8614a9bea65259422279de0041.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26343756/ae7443d3620e5b34f41aa313403ed68f3cd3b1b2.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Exciting News - New Release on Steam!
notes.notes:
I'm very excited to tell you that a new release is now on Steam. 

This release is the first of many to come. This is basically a re-write of the game with improvements to the climbing engine. It's not perfect, but it's a first step of getting everything working so I can focus on adding content. New levels and new mechanics are in the works. I can't wait to start building some really awesome levels. 

** Known Issues **

- Leaderboards have been reset. [strike]There may also be an issue with posting new times to the leaderboards. I'm working on fixing it now.[/strike]. FIXED! 

- If you are walking/running and sliding to a stop, and then try start walking in a new direction, you will continue in the original direction. This is also being worked on. 

- Many of the levels start with the player facing the wrong way. This will be addressed so you always face forward as forward is configured in SteamVR.

** In This Release **

+ Checkpoints - some of the more annoying levels now have checkpoints. If you fall, you will restart at the last checkpoint. (Note - some levels have checkpoints, but will not detect falls yet... Future levels will be designed to make fall detection simpler.. See Level #6 as an example.)

+ Hands! - You now have hands. Also, there is an indicator to show which hand is holding a grip. Customized skin tones will be available in the future. 

+ A few reworked/new levels (Level #6, #19-27)

+ Collision detection should be greatly improved.

** Coming Soon **

+ Many new levels (expect longer more complex levels)
+ New game mechanics (new obstacles, abilities, etc.)
+ Level progression (medals for times, level unlocks)
+ Replays / Ghosts
+ Sound/Music (I know the game is way too quiet)

I'm excited to deliver more content and deliver the great game this is meant to be. 

Thank you!

notes.title: Update - Bug fixes and a new Level #1 (Intro)
notes.notes:
Small update today. 

[b]Updates[/b]

Course #1 has been totally redone. Instead of walking through the basics over the first dozen courses, most of the movement concepts are now introduced in a single level.  It's also more optimized than previous levels and should run pretty smoothly on most systems.

Adaptive Rendering Quality has been added. This should improve the look of the game (on some levels) and will scale based on your PC's performance. 

[b]Bug fixes[/b]

Clipping has been improved. On the new course #1, you should not be able to walk through walls. (your screen will go dark). Some issues may still exists and we will address those in an upcoming release.


[b]Upcoming Changes[/b]

A new Course #2 is now being built that will introduce hazards (fire, lasers, and more). That will go live at the end of the week. 

The early courses (2-15 or so) are also being rebuilt. The current versions were prototypes that will be replaced with all new original designs. 

Music is being added and SFX will be improved. 


-VRoximity

notes.title: Throw / Vault / Jump Bug Fix
notes.notes:
We just released a quick update to address the bug some users encountered. You should be able to leap from grip to grip like tarzan now. Now you can swing from pole to pole as intended.

The bug was causing players to drop straight down when they released a grip on some courses.

If you're looking for a challenge, try the later (18+) levels!

-VRoximity
